task: Reconcile physical-pilot geometry and measurement requirements
acceptance_criteria: Separate chamber volume from syringe displacement, tubing dead volume, gas compressibility and leaks; identify critical geometry, camera accuracy and pressure limits as sourced values or unresolved inputs. Map each fixture to an observable endpoint, not a health claim.
verification: Review against both source documents; retain a requirement-to-part table with units and unresolved decisions.

task: Confirm pilot access, reference geometry and fabrication method
acceptance_criteria: Approve the physical-pilot scope, camera or mocap access, actuator geometry source and reuse/new-mold decision, selected syringe/drive and manufacturing capability. Record actual dimensions or vendor references; unknown critical fits block fabrication.
verification: Owner signs dated decisions and availability references; identify material/process, operator and laboratory approval still needed.
blocker: Owner elects a physical pilot, reconciles the older protocol with the prospective core, and supplies apparatus access plus a reviewed measurement requirement.

task: Model reusable actuator mold and specimen interfaces
acceptance_criteria: Model mold split, core registration, chamber wall thickness, filling/venting, demolding access and casting datums; record shrinkage as an assumption until measured. If an existing released mold is reused, inspect/version that source and document no new mold needed instead of duplicating it.
verification: Regenerate at nominal and reviewed wall-thickness bounds; inspect cross-sections, trapped geometry and mold opening; retain screenshots and dimension checks.
blocker: Requires completed PV-CAD-02 with its recorded input decisions; no modeling has started.

task: Model specimen base and pneumatic-routing fixture
acceptance_criteria: Define repeatable clamping without crushing active chambers, pressure tee locations, strain relief and traceable tubing lengths. Preserve free/contact operating modes selected by the pilot; no fixture contact in the measured motion envelope.
verification: Review assembly mates, full motion clearance and hose routing; retain interference and nominal/dead-volume inventory.
blocker: Requires completed PV-CAD-02 with its recorded input decisions; no modeling has started.

task: Model volumetric-drive mounting and calibration interfaces
acceptance_criteria: Reference the selected commercial drive or model syringe restraints, plunger alignment, travel stops and pinch-zone shielding for a custom drive. Record stroke-to-displacement calibration interface; syringe displacement must not be labeled direct chamber volume.
verification: Check full travel and connector access; produce an error-source diagram covering compliance and gas/tubing effects; qualified review remains necessary before pressurization.
blocker: Requires completed PV-CAD-02 with its recorded input decisions; no modeling has started.

task: Model independent pose target and camera/calibration fixture
acceptance_criteria: Define marker/target attachment, sensor coordinate frame, scale reference and camera or mocap clearance. Quantify added target mass from sourced density and note potential perturbation of actuator pose.
verification: Retain field-of-view and full-motion checks plus target mass calculation; physical pose accuracy is deferred to calibration.
blocker: Requires completed PV-CAD-02, PV-CAD-04 with its recorded input decisions; no modeling has started.

task: Release a reproducible pilot CAD and fabrication-review packet
deliverable: NEW cad/pilot/release/ (BOM, drawings, export manifest, inspection checklist)
acceptance_criteria: Publish editable/version-pinned source, STEP solids, fabrication drawings, dimensions/material/process notes, supplier references, assembly and section visuals. Proposed assets remain labeled CAD/design-only; pressure-test permission and calibration are separate gates.
verification: Second operator reopens exported geometry and checks units, dimensions, part count and assembly fit against source. Retain hashes and review issues; no build approval from this task alone.
blocker: Requires completed PV-CAD-03, PV-CAD-04, PV-CAD-05, PV-CAD-06 with its recorded input decisions; no modeling has started.
